verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at kb.pigment.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) indexing the knowledge base, and markdown versions of the docs served at .md URLs with a 'Documentation Index' pointer. A second llms.txt exists at www.pigment.com/llms.txt for marketing content. An agent can therefore be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on using these agent-oriented docs, and verification of how complete the llms.txt and markdown coverage is (the probe output is truncated; no OpenAPI spec was found).
